# Copilot instructions — ERPNext

ERPNext is **not a standalone application**. It is a [Frappe Framework](https://github.com/frappe/frappe)
app that only runs inside a *bench* (`~/frappe-bench/apps/erpnext`) against a site. Nothing here can
be executed with a bare `python erpnext/...`.

## Canonical sources (read these, do not restate them)

| Topic | File |
| --- | --- |
| Lint / format / import order | `pyproject.toml` (`[tool.ruff]`), `.eslintrc` |
| Pre-commit gates | `.pre-commit-config.yaml` |
| Commit message rules | `commitlint.config.js` |
| PR expectations | `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` |
| Issue expectations | `.github/CONTRIBUTING.md` |
| CI (source of truth for how tests run) | `.github/workflows/server-tests-mariadb.yml` |
| Postgres portability rules | `.github/POSTGRES_COMPATIBILITY.md` |
| Code ownership / reviewers | `CODEOWNERS` |

If any instruction below conflicts with those files, **those files win**.

## Repository layout

- `erpnext/<module>/doctype/<doctype>/` — one folder per DocType: `.json` (schema, generated by the
  UI — hand-edit only when you know the field metadata format), `.py` (server controller),
  `.js` (client form script), `test_<doctype>.py`.
- `erpnext/controllers/` — shared base classes. The inheritance chain is
  `Document` → `TransactionBase` → `AccountsController` → `{Selling,Buying,Stock,Subcontracting}Controller`
  → concrete DocType controller. **Put shared transaction logic here, never copy it between DocTypes.**
- `erpnext/<module>/report/<report>/` — query reports (`.py` + `.json`, optional `.js` filters).
- `erpnext/patches/` + `patches.txt` — one-shot data migrations, append-only and ordered.
- `erpnext/hooks.py` — all framework wiring: `doc_events`, `scheduler_events`, `override_doctype_class`,
  `regional_overrides`, `doctype_js`, fixtures, website routes.
- `erpnext/regional/` — country-specific behaviour, dispatched through `regional_overrides` in
  `hooks.py`. Never branch on country inside a core controller.
- `banking/` — separate Vite/React SPA, built into `erpnext/public/banking` (see `[tool.bench.assets]`).

## Working rules

1. **Server-side authority.** All business logic and validation lives in Python. Client scripts are
   convenience only — never the sole enforcement point (see `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`).
2. **Reuse before adding.** Before writing a helper, search `erpnext/controllers/`,
   `erpnext/accounts/utils.py`, `erpnext/stock/utils.py`, `erpnext/setup/utils.py` and the relevant
   module's `utils.py`. Duplicated logic across DocTypes is a review blocker.
3. **Query with the ORM.** Prefer `frappe.db.get_value/get_all/set_value` and `frappe.qb`
   (`frappe.query_builder`) over raw SQL. Raw SQL must pass `.github/helper/postgres_compat.py` and
   the rules in `.github/POSTGRES_COMPATIBILITY.md` — MariaDB-only syntax breaks the Postgres job.
4. **Never build SQL with f-strings or `%` on user input.** Use parameter binding.
5. **User-facing strings go through `_()`** (`from frappe import _`) so Crowdin can pick them up.
6. **Whitelisted endpoints** (`@frappe.whitelist()`) are attacker-reachable. Validate every argument,
   and enforce permissions explicitly (`doc.check_permission(...)`, `frappe.only_for(...)`) — the
   decorator alone grants access to any logged-in user.
7. **Schema changes need a patch.** Renaming/removing a field or changing its meaning requires a new
   module under `erpnext/patches/` plus an entry appended to `patches.txt`.
8. **Backwards compatibility.** Deprecations go through `erpnext/deprecation_dumpster.py`, not
   straight deletion.
9. **Scope.** Fix the reported problem only. Do not reformat untouched files, bump dependencies, or
   "improve" adjacent code — `ruff-format` reformatting noise makes a PR unreviewable.

## Style

Enforced by `ruff` — **tabs for indentation**, double quotes, line length 110. Do not hand-format;
run the formatter. Type hints use `frappe.types.DF` for DocType fields.

```sh
pre-commit run --all-files    # or, on a fork without the hooks installed:
ruff check --select=I --fix . && ruff check . && ruff format .
```

## Tests

Tests are Frappe test cases (`frappe.tests.UnitTestCase` / `IntegrationTestCase`), run through bench —
`unittest`/`pytest` invoked directly will fail on missing site context.

```sh
cd ~/frappe-bench
bench --site test_site run-tests --app erpnext --module erpnext.setup.doctype.transaction_deletion_record.test_transaction_deletion_record
bench --site test_site run-tests --app erpnext --doctype "Sales Invoice"
```

Every bug fix needs a regression test in the corresponding `test_<doctype>.py`, asserting the
behaviour that was broken — not just that the code runs.

## Commits and PRs

Conventional commits, type from the enum in `commitlint.config.js`
(`build|chore|ci|docs|feat|fix|perf|refactor|revert|style|test`):

```
fix(Transaction Deletion Record): tolerate short rows in CSV import

closes #<issue>
```

Target the `develop` branch. Backports to version branches are handled by `.mergify.yml` labels — do
not open them manually. Fill in the PR template: the problem, why the change is necessary, and a
screenshot/GIF when the UI is affected.
